raw_answer_text:
A1: It is broadcast to every station on the segment (dst MAC ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff), not sent to one specific station.
A2: Host A's ARP cache has no entry for B's IP address before the exchange.
A3: NOT STATED
A4: No — other hosts on the LAN (C, D, ...) hear the broadcast but ignore it, sending nothing back.
A5: The reply is sent directly (unicast) to just the requesting host, Host A.
A6: Host A caches the information, resulting in an entry mapping B's IP → aa:bb:cc:..., learned from the reply.
A7: The requesting host does not know the target's hardware address; obtaining that address is precisely the purpose of the request.
A8: NOT STATED
